Author: Arceuid731 / Team Wrath
Name: Wrath Combo Enhanced
Description: Learn your rotation with red damage highlights, green healing highlights, and four compact next-action windows for single-target and AoE rotations. Each window shows its suggested target and can be moved or resized. Includes Wrath Combo's one-button rotations. Open settings with /wce. Enable only one Wrath Combo edition at a time.
Punchline: Wrath rotations with separate damage and healing guidance.
Changelog: Four independent guidance channels: damage and healing, each with single-target and AoE suggestions. AoE highlights use a double frame. Adjust Highlight padding (px) for more space around icons. Next-action windows are compact horizontal cards without titles, with a subtle color accent and an AoE badge. Existing colors and positions are preserved; window sizes adopt the compact layout once.
